preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a binary string where each character is either '0' or '1'
N is the length of the binary string S
The length of S is at least 1
T is the number of test cases, where 1 ≤ T ≤ 4000

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the maximum number of '01' substrings achievable by swapping characters at indices of the same parity (both odd or both even) any number of times

postconditions.expression: max_01_occurrences(S) == sum(1 for i in range(len(S)-1) if S[i] == '0' and S[i+1] == '1')
postconditions.description: The function `max_01_occurrences(S)` computes the maximum number of '01' substrings in S after performing valid swaps, where a '01' substring is defined as S[i] == '0' and S[i+1] == '1' for some index i

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= max_01_occurrences(S) <= len(S)-1 for S in test_cases)
postconditions.description: The result for each test case is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum possible '01' substrings in a string of length N (which is N-1)
